title: Six words
rule: Six panels, each captioned with a single word; no balloons.
declares: the four lines replaced by six single words
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p97_six_words.py (pen and panels: build/p51_pen_alone.py; figure model: build/b1m2.py)
made: six panels in a 2x3 grid, each a pen drawing over a ruled caption band holding one word: Errand. / Time? / Clock. / Thanks. / Key. / Why?

drawings in page 51's one-weight pen (4.42 px, hidden lines lifted) over page 05's HANDMADE figure model (b1m2 agent with spectacles, waistcoat, pencil; stranger with hat behind the ticket window; desk, clock at 4:10, cupboard, key on its hook, SERVICE door)

everything page 51 lettered is drawn unlettered so no seventh word appears: the memo as a ruled slip of pen scribble lines, the ticket-window header blank, the SERVICE door card and the key tag as blank ruled boxes
caption words in the shared pen hand (pen99.letter, cap 116, weight 0.105); LoC 1934 sheet as the only ground; folio by pen99.folio

events.E0: P1 'Errand.': memo slip on the desk, he walks from it toward the closed cupboard
events.E1: P2 'Time?': she at the ticket window, he stopped facing her
events.E2: P3 'Clock.': he looks up at the clock at 4:10
events.E3: P4 'Thanks.': she turns and leaves the window
events.E4: P5 'Key.': the cupboard open, the key on its hook
events.E5: P6 'Why?': pencil to his chin; key still on its hook; the SERVICE door shut

substitutions: the four lines become the single words Time? (question), Clock. (answer), Thanks. (thanks), Why? (forgetting); Errand. and Key. caption E0 and E4
beat: the page written panel by panel: each picture drawn, then its one word lettered under it; the cupboard drawn shut then open; 'Why?' written last
beat_frames: b01: frames ruled, P1 drawn (he has just left the desk), no word
b05: P5 with the cupboard shut
b06: the cupboard open, the key on its hook, 'Key.'
b07: P6 drawn, pencil at chin, no word

self_check.check: A reader counts exactly six words on the page outside the margin -> Errand, Time, Clock, Thanks, Key, Why; memo scribble, blank cards and tag carry no letters; the folio line is the margin
self_check.evidence: measured (size, word lists) and perceptually judged from the full-size page by the maker; blind reading pending

weaknesses: without the memo text, TICKET OFFICE and SERVICE lettering, the objects lean on their drawing and the six words: the SERVICE door is only 'a door with a blank card', and why the key matters is carried by 'Errand.' + 'Key.' alone
'Clock.' names what he looks at rather than what he answers; the exact time is legible only from the clock hands
the stranger is the b1m2 cut-paper model drawn in outline; her hat reads oddly behind the glazing bars
the caption rule sits just under the floor line, so each panel ends in a double rule
